text:
maria: Quick question for the group — for Private deployments using envelope encryption, what's our recommended pattern to let the app unwrap DEKs with Cloud KMS while keeping the key material in a central ops project? Thinking about least-privilege SA scoping, cross-project impersonation, audit logs (DATA_ACCESS), and rotation/rewrap. Any concise playbook or example bindings? @devon @ryan

devon: Short answer: prefer cross-project impersonation + short-lived credentials rather than granting KMS roles directly to customer-side SAs. That keeps the key in ops project and gives us better control + audit trail. Key pieces: 1) ops SA (in ops project) holds `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the key; 2) runtime in customer project impersonates that ops SA with `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` granted to a limited SA; 3) audit sinks for DATA_ACCESS enabled.

ryan: Example IAM flow:

```
# Ops project
projects/ops-proj/locations/global/keyRings/secure-ring/cryptoKeys/app-key
  -> grant roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter to ops-sa@ops-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com

# Customer project
# Grant iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on ops-sa to runtime-sa@cust-proj
runtime-sa@cust-proj    -> roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator on ops-sa
```

ryan: Then runtime uses IAM generateAccessToken/impersonate to get short-lived credentials and calls `projects.locations.keyRings.cryptoKeys:decrypt` in ops project. This avoids giving the runtime direct KMS permissions in ops project.

olivia: A few operational gotchas: 1) ensure `DATA_ACCESS` audit logging is enabled for Cloud KMS in the ops project (it's off by default for many services), otherwise you won't see decrypt events; 2) export audit logs to a dedicated BigQuery dataset / GCS bucket with alerting on `serviceName=cloudkms.googleapis.com` + `methodName: CryptoKeyVersions.*` or `CryptoKey.*decrypt`.

maria: For rotation — do we rewrap all stored DEKs with new key version or rotate the cryptoKey and keep the same key resource? Want pros/cons.

dmitri: Practically: create a new key version in the same cryptoKey (Cloud KMS supports key versions). Workflow: 1) generate new version; 2) for each stored wrapped DEK, call `decrypt` with the old version and `encrypt` with the new version (rewrap); 3) update metadata to reference new wrapped DEK. Avoid creating separate cryptoKeys unless you need audit separation. Rewraps allow you to keep resource identity and reduce config churn.

devon: Also consider using asymmetric keys for signing workflows, but for envelope unwrap/encrypt symmetric keys are typical. Keep rewrap tool idempotent and throttle to avoid bursting KMS QPS.

maria: What minimum IAM bindings do we need on the ops SA so that impersonation doesn't blow up our principle of least privilege?

ryan: Minimal: ops-sa only needs `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` on the cryptoKey + no other broad roles. In the customer project, grant `roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator` to runtime SA specifically on the ops SA principal. Audit logs will show the impersonated principal as `serviceAccount:runtime-sa@cust-proj` but the `actor` will show `impersonator` metadata — you can correlate with `serviceAccountDelegationInfo`.

olivia: Example policy snippet (for docs):

```
# On ops project key
bindings:
- role: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter
  members:
  - serviceAccount:ops-sa@ops-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com

# On ops project (or org) give token creator to runtime sa principal
bindings:
- role: roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator
  members:
  - serviceAccount:runtime-sa@cust-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  resource: //iam.googleapis.com/projects/ops-proj/serviceAccounts/ops-sa@ops-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

maria: About audit: you said enable DATA_ACCESS. Any fields we should index/alert on?

olivia: Alerts we use: 1) methodName contains `Decrypt` or `AsymmetricDecrypt`; 2) resourceName matches the cryptoKey resource; 3) protoPayload.requestMetadata.callerIp for unusual locations; 4) `serviceAccountDelegationInfo` to detect cross-project impersonation spikes. Also keep retention long enough (90d+) for investigations; export to BigQuery for fast querying.

audit-bot: Reminder: Cloud Audit Logs for DATA_ACCESS may incur cost when exported to BigQuery. Confirm budget with finance before long retention. :money_with_wings: 

maria: For Private/on-prem variant where ops control plane is customer-hosted, do we recommend local HSM or Cloud KMS?

devon: If truly air-gapped, use on-prem HSM (customer provided) and adjust the envelope layer to call local KMS via a well-defined adapter. If you can reach GCP, central Cloud KMS is easier operationally. Regardless, keep the same principle: ops key-holding identity + short-lived unwrap path + audit sink.

maria: Thanks all — can someone assemble a short playbook I can paste into the onboarding doc?

olivia: I'll draft a 1-page playbook + terraform snippet for the impersonation flow this week. Assigning to me.

maria: Perfect. Marking this thread resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
